description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the acquisition of the Land in Weralugastenna, Raththota D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It details the compensation deposit for acquiring specific land parcels (Midkar Watta/Medawatta, Lots 6 and 7), including their plan numbers, extent, and precise location. The content focuses solely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized administrative matters, making it a clear Land Gazette.
